evidence: The worklist jobs_spec (wd:leonardocompany/wd3/LeonardoCareerSite) is actually Leonardo S.p.A.'s parent board (Italy/UK/Germany postings only, no US listings) -- not Leonardo DRS. Leonardo DRS runs its own career site at careers.leonardodrs.com (no jobs.py spec support). Searched it for 'new grad' and '2027': found only Spring/Summer 2027 Software/Systems Engineering internships and co-ops (Beavercreek OH, Menomonee Falls WI, Bridgeton MO), no live full-time new-grad SWE posting. As a defense contractor, full-time SWE roles here typically require US citizenship/clearance, but no live posting to quote.
